map_avatar.crop_rule: Preserve asymmetric sprout, hood silhouette, face/hood negative space, warm scarf accent and boot/base read.

hud_portrait.crop_rule: Head plus upper torso; retain sprout, hood contour and scarf diagonal.

encounter_halfbody.crop_rule: Head to mid-thigh; satchel strap and expression pose remain legible.

result_large.crop_rule: Full expressive pose; never crop sprout or boots.

companion_portrait.crop_rule: Portrait-biased current-mood pose while preserving hood/sprout identity.

journal_crop.crop_rule: Warm paper artifact crop; simplify micro-detail at small sizes rather than sharpening.

affinity_rule.base: canonical outfit; no extra keepsake emphasis
affinity_rule.familiar: small shared-travel accent such as leaf tag or stitching
affinity_rule.trusted: route charm / compass / richer satchel keepsake while anatomy remains unchanged
affinity_rule.best_friend: BF-B restrained personal keepsake cluster; no species, anatomy, crown or major costume transformation

qa_required_before_runtime_promotion: face and eye readability across LIGHT/WARM_DUSK/DARK
no anatomy/costume drift from approved Candidate 3
affinity progression uses keepsake/patch/charm treatment only
transparent edge and halo check on light/dark/map backgrounds
v1 rollback/fallback pack remains available until v2 activation passes
promotion_rule: Do not overwrite or silently repoint the existing runtime Moru pack. Add v2 as a new semantic profile/version and promote only after transparent raster exports and mobile QA pass.
